Here is Form 22 filled in for you as the applicant. Items marked "leave for the property manager" are theirs to complete. NEEDS-YOU marks details I don't have.

Things to fix by hand after the real values go back in:
- B08 and B18, Postcode: these boxes get your whole home address. Delete everything except the UK postcode, and in the address boxes before them, delete the postcode so it doesn't appear twice.
- B07, Date of birth: your date goes in the way your passport prints it. If that isn't a plain day/month/year (for example 15/03/1985), rewrite it in that form, which is what Australian forms use.
- B09, Phone: add the UK country code if it's missing. Write +44 and drop the leading 0, so an Australian agent can call you.

Also note:
- The form says every adult applicant needs their own separate form. Your wife should fill in her own Form 22. Your daughter needs one too if she is 18 or older. If she is under 18, she only counts in item 4.
- The form mentions information about tenancy databases (item 15), but that part wasn't in the text you sent. Read it on the full form before you sign.
